claim: NR4/NR7 are mechanical range-rank flags (narrowest of last 4/7 bars) from Crabel; the page asserts, without measurement, that a narrow bar "frequently" precedes a larger bar, and says the flag is direction-neutral.
quote: Frequently is not always; narrow bars also crowd into dead, choppy tape and ahead of holidays.
title: LuxAlgo NR4/NR7 concept

claim: NR flags are binary and ignore narrowness relative to normal volatility, so practitioners add an ATR check.
quote: Both are binary flags that ignore how narrow the bar is relative to normal volatility, so many traders add an absolute-range or ATR check on top.
title: LuxAlgo NR4/NR7 concept

claim: Bollinger BandWidth squeeze is defined as bands narrowing; StockCharts example uses BandWidth below 10 (10% of the middle band) for ALK and warns of head-fake breaks. Assertion, not a measured test.
quote: The theory is that periods of low volatility are followed by periods of high volatility.
title: StockCharts Bollinger BandWidth

claim: Vendor self-reported single-stock backtest (Best Buy, ~21 years to 2025) of BandWidth crossing above 10; says BandWidth does not predict direction. No baseline for expansion prediction across assets.
quote: Even though Bollinger Bandwidth doesn’t predict which way price will move
title: SentimenTrader Bollinger Bandwidth

claim: Gamma-theta P&L identity for delta-hedged long straddle: dP&L ~ 0.5*Gamma*S^2*(realized var - implied var)*dt, under fixed-IV, continuous hedging, zero financing.
quote: dP&L ≈ ½ Γ S² (σ² realized − σ² implied ) dt
title: FlashAlpha gamma scalping guide

claim: ATM straddle daily breakeven move is approx S*IV/sqrt(252) (e.g. 13% IV gives ~0.82%/day); vendor page, hypothetical inputs, and realized variance above IV does not guarantee profit once discrete hedging, costs and IV changes are included.
title: FlashAlpha gamma scalping guide

claim: Long straddle has positive vega: loses money when implied vol falls; strangle is more sensitive to time decay than a straddle and has a greater chance of losing 100% at expiry (Fidelity education).
quote: When volatility falls, long straddles decrease in price and lose money.
title: Fidelity Long Straddle

claim: Strangle breakevens are further apart and strangle suffers greater percentage loss than comparable straddle when price is flat.
quote: Thus, when there is little or no stock price movement, a long strangle will experience a greater percentage loss over a given time period than a comparable straddle.
title: Fidelity Long Straddle

claim: Vendor self-reported: 9,622 S&P 500 earnings ATM straddles 2021-2026, entered 9 DTE before print and exited next session at bid/ask: win rate 22.0%, mean P&L -18.47%/trade, median -26.45%, mean IV crush 15.64 vol pts.
quote: Win rate 22.0% , mean P&L −18.47% per trade, median −26.45% , total $-loss $21 812 across SP500 5 years.
title: IVolatility earnings straddles stress test
